blocks.h2: When to Replace Your Water Heater

tiles.body: Rust has worked through the tank. It can't be repaired.
Check the date on the label and plan ahead.
Two or three repairs in a few years is a sign.
A larger household or new bathroom.

blocks.h2: How We Install Your New Water Heater

steps.body: Capacity and recovery matched to your household.
New shutoff, connectors, an expansion tank where needed, gas and vent checked.
Drained, hauled away and the new one tested.

blocks.h2: Water Heater Installs in Geneva Homes
blocks.intro: Installing a water heater in Geneva can be very different from one house to the next.

items.body: In older homes, getting the old heater out and the new one in can take planning. We measure the path and the space first.
A new gas heater venting alone into an oversized masonry chimney may need a liner or a power-vent model.

If your 1990s or 2000s home still has its first heater, replacing it before it leaks protects a finished basement. It's also a good time to consider a [tankless water heater](/geneva/tankless-water-heater).

blocks.h2: Water Heater Installation Questions From Geneva Homeowners

items.q: Can you install a water heater in a tight historic basement?
items.preview: Yes. We plan the route and measure first.
items.answer: Yes. We measure the stairs, doorways and space before we quote. If a standard tank won't fit, we'll suggest a model that will.

items.q: Can you replace it the same day?
items.answer: Often, yes. Standard tank heaters are usually available. Tankless and specialty units may take longer.

items.q: What size water heater do I need?
items.preview: Most households do well with 40 to 50 gallons.
items.answer: Most households of three or four do well with 40 or 50 gallons. Bigger households or soaking tubs may need more.

items.q: Do I need a chimney liner?
items.preview: Sometimes, if the heater vents alone into an old chimney.
items.answer: If your new gas heater will be the only appliance venting into an old masonry chimney, a liner or a power-vent heater may be needed for a safe draft. We'll check.

items.q: How much does water heater installation cost in Geneva?
items.preview: It depends on type, size and code updates. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the type and size of heater, the venting and any code updates. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
